name: Fill the Pipeline
tagline: From a fresh lead list to the meeting booked.
rationale: Outbound dies in the gaps: no list, a generic opener, the wrong contact, a yes that never gets a calendar invite. This bundle closes each one — a fresh qualified list every morning, a real hook per account, a path to the actual decision-maker, a daily read of buying signals, and a bot that books the calls that slipped. You keep a human hand on every send.

members.name: Prospecting Sheet Builder
members.reason: Wakes you up to a fresh sheet of qualified B2B accounts, so the day starts with a list, not a blank page.

members.name: PG (Prospecting)
members.reason: Works the target accounts first, mining recent podcasts and webinars for an opener that isn't scraped from a profile.

members.name: John Wick
members.reason: Maps the target company and climbs upward until it reaches the person who can actually say yes.

members.name: Linkedin Leads
members.reason: Sweeps LinkedIn posts and comments for your keywords every day and surfaces the real buying signals.

members.name: Dispatch
members.reason: Scans your channels nightly and books the calls that were agreed to but never actually scheduled.
